indicator.title: Außenbeitrag in % des BIP
indicator.description: Exporte minus Importe von Gütern und Dienstleistungen in Prozent des Bruttoinlandsprodukts; positive Werte bedeuten Überschuss, negative Werte Defizit.

source.indicatorName: External balance on goods and services (% of GDP)
source.sourceNote: The balance of international trade in goods and services is the difference between the exports and imports of goods and services. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.
